title: Host-addressed artifact URIs must pass the host policy before the server connects to them
answers: server connects to an arbitrary host from an experiment artifact location
tracking server SSRF through artifact_location or model version source
why does creating an experiment with an hdfs or ftp artifact location get rejected on the server
register model source on another storage host rejected by the tracking server
body:
Symptom: A client creates an experiment, workspace or model version whose artifact location is on another storage host (ftp, sftp, hdfs, viewfs, http(s), mlflow-artifacts, r2, b2, abfss), and the tracking server later contacts that host when serving artifacts.
Root cause: mlflow/store/artifact/artifact_repository_registry.py:ArtifactRepositoryRegistry.get_artifact_repository built repositories from the stored URI without any host check, and the storage-location and model-source validators in mlflow/server/handlers.py did not look at the host.
Fix pattern: Check the URI with mlflow/store/artifact/host_policy.py:rejected_host_addressed_scheme in request validators (handlers.py:_validate_artifact_uri_scheme, which gives a field-specific 400), in the registry (enforce_server_artifact_uri_host_policy), and in stored-location construction (handlers.py:_get_artifact_repository_for_uri).
Constraints: Enforcement applies only when the server-process marker is set, so client processes are unaffected. Trusted hosts are those of the server's default artifact root and artifacts destination, plus per-scheme opt-in via MLFLOW_ALLOWED_HOST_ADDRESSED_ARTIFACT_SCHEMES. Proxied http(s) roots under --serve-artifacts never reach the handler guard. A scheme may join HOST_ADDRESSED_ARTIFACT_SCHEMES only after its repository's endpoint derivation is checked (r2/b2/abfss were added that way; wasbs was not).
applies: Any new or changed handler, validator or repository path that turns a stored or client-supplied artifact URI into a connection in a server process.
says: Registering a model pointing to external cloud storage host is rejected by the server.
The tracking server rejects creating experiments with custom remote storage locations.
Allow configuring trusted remote storage endpoints for model artifacts and experiment data.
Prevent the tracking server from reaching out to unapproved third party storage hosts.
Experiment creation fails with an invalid storage scheme error when using external servers.
search: Tracking server handlers and artifact repository constructors must validate host-addressed artifact URIs against host policy before connecting to external storage hosts. Validation is enforced in mlflow/server/handlers.py:_validate_artifact_uri_scheme, handlers.py:_get_artifact_repository_for_uri, and ArtifactRepositoryRegistry.get_artifact_repository using host_policy.py functions. Enforcement applies only in server processes, trusting default artifact roots or schemes opted in via MLFLOW_ALLOWED_HOST_ADDRESSED_ARTIFACT_SCHEMES. Adding schemes to HOST_ADDRESSED_ARTIFACT_SCHEMES requires verified endpoint derivation, while proxied http(s) roots under --serve-artifacts bypass handler checks.
